These terms govern your use of Contamos,: These terms govern your use of Contamos, which is operated by :entity. Creating an account means you accept them. If you do not accept them, do not use the service.
Contamos is a shared multi-currency ledg: Contamos is a shared multi-currency ledger. It records what its members enter and nothing else: it is not accounting software, it is not financial, legal or tax advice, and it does not connect to your bank.
What the ledger shows is what the people: What the ledger shows is what the people in your team typed into it. Check it before you rely on it.
You need an account to use Contamos and: You need an account to use Contamos and you are responsible for what is done with it. You must be old enough to enter into a contract where you live.

Everything recorded in a team is visible: Everything recorded in a team is visible to every member of that team, carrying the name of whoever recorded it. Invite only people you mean to share your ledger with.
A team owner can change roles, remove me: A team owner can change roles, remove members, and delete the team together with everything recorded in it. That deletion cannot be undone.
Do not use Contamos to break the law, to: Do not use Contamos to break the law, to reach data that is not yours, to disrupt or overload the service, or to resell it as your own. We may suspend or close an account that does.
The Free plan costs nothing and limits h: The Free plan costs nothing and limits how many accounts, members and teams you can have and how much history is shown. Nothing is ever deleted because of those limits.
Pro removes the limits and is billed mon: Pro removes the limits and is billed monthly or yearly through Paddle.com Market Ltd, our merchant of record, until you cancel it. The price is shown before you pay. Refunds are covered by our refund policy.

You keep every right to what you record. You give us only the permission we need to store it, show it to the members of your teams and back it up so the service works.
